name: cavemio-image-compare
title: Image compare
description: Two images, one precise divide. Drag to reveal what changed, then let the handle settle.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The handle exposes slider semantics and percentage value. Arrows move 1%; Shift and arrows move 10%; Home and End reveal either side.
- Double-click centres the divide. Pointer cancellation restores the original value, and vertical touch scrolling remains available.
- Reduced motion removes settling transitions. Direct dragging still follows the pointer.
- Image load failures show a labelled fallback with the frame dimensions preserved.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: before / after
props.description: – · src, alt and optional className for each image. Supply aligned images for a meaningful comparison.

props.name: beforeLabel / afterLabel
props.description: Before / After · Labels on each visible side.

props.name: value / defaultValue
props.description: 50 · Controlled or initial reveal percentage, clamped to 0–100.

props.name: onValueChange / onValueCommit
props.description: – · Continuous position updates and committed releases or keyboard changes.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: 1.6 · Width divided by height. Both images occupy this same frame.

props.name: label
props.description: Image comparison · Accessible name for the region and slider.

features.title: Drag to reveal
features.description: Press anywhere and the divide is thrown to your finger, then follows it exactly with no repaint.

features.title: It settles on the middle
features.description: Release close to the centre and it settles at exactly 50%. Double-click centres it.

features.title: Keyboard control
features.description: Arrows move 1%, Shift with arrows moves 10%, and Home and End reveal either side.

features.title: Edges stay reachable
features.description: The handle stays inside a small inset, so it can still be grabbed when one image is fully shown.

features.title: Touch scrolling still works
features.description: Vertical touch movement scrolls the page, and an interrupted drag restores the position.

features.title: Broken images are handled
features.description: A failed image shows a labelled fallback with the frame’s size preserved.

states.title: drag
states.description: A press throws the divide to the pointer over 420ms, then it follows exactly. The window, picture, divider and handle move with transforms on their own layers; no React render or repaint per move.

states.title: settle
states.description: A release within 3% of centre settles at 50%. Keyboard and controlled changes ease over 420ms.

states.title: ends
states.description: Home and End reveal either image completely. The handle remains inside a 22px inset so it can still be grabbed.

states.title: cancel
states.description: An interrupted pointer gesture restores the position from before the drag.
